editorialContext.instruction: Cover finalized Week 9 results and the Week 10 schedule. Do not invent game chronology from final box scores; current injury labels describe capture-time status, not automatically an injury sustained this week.
editorialContext.finalitySource: Sleeper league settings.last_scored_leg confirms Week 9 is complete.
editorialContext.mickeyMethod: Lowest-scoring actual winner, equivalent here to the winning team with the fewest all-play wins; all-play compares each score with the other eleven teams, and ties count as half a win in expected win share.
